newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Pioneer Grain to build seventh elevator.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Pioneer Grain to build seventh elevator.

text.p: Canada's Pioneer Grain Co Ltd said on Monday it plans to build a seventh high through put elevator north of Saskatoon, Saskatchewan.
The concrete elevator and farm service center will hold 18,000 tonnes and cost between C$7 and C$10 million to build, said Jim Weir, vice president of parent company James Richardson International.
The elevator will have a 52-car rail siding along the Canadian National Railway Co.
Three other similar Pioneer facilities are under construction in Saskatchewan and three others are being built by the company in Manitoba.
